subject: POC runway boost request — integration blocked by runtime mismatch
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@blueharbor.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: short trial top-up — integration blocked by runtime error

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the model options. We're midway through a POC (internal name: ‘QuickSearch’) and have hit a runtime mismatch during the connector handshake that prevents us from running the full ingestion and evaluation. Our engineers are looking at it but it's a blocker for our next verification milestone.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a 2-week trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up (~200k tokens) so we can validate the fix without killing our quota?
- Can we get a short engineering-to-engineering touchpoint tomorrow morning (30 min) to walk through the logs I attached?

Attached: build_error_log_20270619.zip and a screenshot of the CI failure.

We're trying to hit the demo window with our execs on July 6 — an extension would keep momentum. Happy to take whatever approvals you need on your side.

Cheers,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Blue Harbor AI
alicia@blueharbor.ai
+1 415-555-0134
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: short trial top-up — integration blocked by runtime error

Hi Alicia — thanks for the detail and the logs. Sorry to hear you hit this at a critical moment.

We're happy to help. Quick plan:
- I've looped in Marcus (runtime infra) and Priya (your AE) to validate the logs and confirm a token top-up.
- From an account side we're prepared to offer a 2-week extension and an initial 150k sandbox token top-up while engineering triages. If Marcus confirms the issue is limited and short-lived, we can approve an additional 50k on the same ticket (200k total).

Mutual action items:
1) Marcus to give technical assessment and suggested workaround (by EOD Sun).
2) Alicia to share any additional stack traces and a short recording of the reproducer if available.
3) Priya will prepare the credit + extension paperwork if we get green light from Marcus/Rishi.

Would 09:30 PT tomorrow work for a 30-min screen-share? I can host a Redwood meeting link.

Thanks — we'll do our best to keep your demo window intact.

Best,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: short trial top-up — integration blocked by runtime error

Quick technical read: I pulled the attached log — looks like a mismatch between the connector's sequence-length handling and our KV cache warm-up on the first few requests. Reproducer is small (we can run it in a sandbox).

Proposed approach:
- Short-term: apply a small config change on the session initialization that avoids the KV warm-up path; this is a low-risk change for the sandbox and should unblock the POC. Estimated wall time: ~3 hours including verification.
- Tokens: running the repro and two verification runs will consume ~20–30k tokens. Full end-to-end testing across your sample corpus might need ~120–150k tokens depending on prompt lengths.

Given this, the 200k top-up Mina proposed is reasonable. From an infra perspective I approve applying the sandbox config tweak and running the validation. I'll join the call tomorrow and bring the reproducer.

— Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Thanks team — good triage. Priya, approve a one-time 200k sandbox token credit and a 2-week extension for Blue Harbor AI (deal BH-3245). Please add a CRM note: credit granted for integration blocker; expire 2027-07-05.

Priya, also confirm with Alicia on the 09:30 PT screen-share and send the short Doc (POC credit terms). I'm fine with Marcus making the sandbox tweak.
